summary: Frontend-only verification of the Novaro SPA via the public preview URL. All 6 requested items PASS: (1) landing page GET / returns 200 with Novaro logo (loaded, naturalWidth=1024), sky background asset (bg-sky.jpg on .starfield) and footer text 'Submission for Building Indonesia AI Contest by Emergent'; (2) GET /app loads with ZERO console/page errors and zero failed requests on first load; (3) demo login button ('Coba tanpa kode - Mode Demo', #demoBtn) reaches the dashboard - health score dial rendered (47/100) plus 'FOKUS USAHA HARI INI' card; (4) access-code login with 101/102/105/106/107 all reach the dashboard (e.g. 'Halo, Warung Nasi Bu Rina!', score 80/100) with health score + 'Fokus usaha hari ini'; (5) all 6 top nav tabs (Dasbor, Buku Kas, Rekomendasi, Konsultasi AI, Modul, Profil) and the mobile bottom tabbar switch views correctly with content rendered and no JS errors or 4xx/5xx; (6) AI chat (Konsultasi AI) shows 'Online - AI Gemini 2.5' and streamed a full, data-grounded Indonesian answer to 'Labaku sebulan berapa?' within ~6s (real Gemini, correct laba bersih computation from the account's numbers). Tested at 1920x1080 and 390x844. No files were modified (verification-only task).

issues: The mobile bottom navigation (#tabbar) renders on desktop as well (computed display:grid, height>0 at 1920px), so the app shows duplicated navigation (top nav + fixed bottom tabbar) and the tabbar covers the bottom ~60px of dashboard content. Root cause: the .tabbar CSS block in /app/server/public/index.html (~lines 535-554) is NOT wrapped in a max-width media query - there is a stray closing '}' after '#toast{bottom:88px}' and duplicated rules (.nav-links button and .tabbar button .ic are each declared twice), indicating the '@media(max-width:...)' wrapper was lost during an edit.

Horizontal overflow: document.scrollWidth=537 vs clientWidth=390. The dashboard '.hero-row' / '.grid-2' (grid-template-columns:1.1fr .9fr and 1fr 1fr, index.html lines 240/244) never collapse to a single column because the file has no max-width breakpoints, so the 'Angka usahamu bulan ini' card is cut off and the page scrolls sideways.

The sky background (.starfield, bg-sky.jpg) is present but rendered with opacity:var(--stars)=0 in light mode, so it is only visible when the OS/browser prefers dark. If the sky visual is intended branding on the landing page it is invisible for light-mode visitors. Low priority / possibly intentional.

action_items: Restore the missing '@media (max-width: ...)' wrapper around the .tabbar / #toast block in /app/server/public/index.html so the bottom tabbar only appears on small screens (and remove the stray '}' + duplicated .nav-links button / .tabbar button .ic rules).
Add mobile breakpoints so .hero-row / .grid-2 / .form-grid / .kas-summary collapse to one column below ~640px - dashboard currently overflows horizontally (537px content in a 390px viewport).

Optional: add data-testid attributes to SPA interactive elements (login input/button, demo button, nav buttons, chat input/send, dashboard score) - the SPA currently has ZERO data-testid attributes, so all automation relies on ids/text.
Optional: /app/memory/test_credentials.md does not exist (nor /app/memory). Consider adding it with the demo access codes 101-120 for future test agents.

Optional/environmental: the only console error observed on /app is the Cloudflare analytics beacon (static.cloudflareinsights.com/beacon.min.js) being blocked by the app's own CSP (script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'). It is injected by the preview edge, not by app code, and does not affect functionality. First (non-reloaded) load of /app had zero console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/server/public/index.html is 4380 lines / 216 KB with the entire SPA in one inline <script> - well over the 700-line guideline; consider splitting into modules for maintainability.
CSS brace mismatch around the .tabbar block silently disabled the mobile-only media query - a CSS linter in CI would have caught this.
No data-testid attributes anywhere in the SPA; automated tests depend on ids and Indonesian copy, which is brittle.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of the 6 requested functional checks passed; 3 responsive/design issues found

seed_data_creation: None created. Used existing demo accounts via POST /api/demo (demo button) and access codes 101, 102, 105, 106, 107. No data was written beyond consent acceptance for those demo accounts.
test_credentials: Access codes 101-120 (used 101/102/105/106/107); demo login needs no code. /app/memory/test_credentials.md is missing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: SPA selectors (no data-testid exists): #authScreen, #codeInput, #loginBtn, #demoBtn ('Coba tanpa kode - Mode Demo'), #consentScreen + #consentAgree (consent may appear after login; in these runs it did not for codes 101-107 or demo), #app, #greeting, #dashBody (contains the score dial '<n> dari 100'), #navLinks button[data-page='dasbor|kas|rekomendasi|konsultasi|modul|profil'], #tabbar button[data-page=...], #chatForm/#chatInput/#chatSend/#chatLog/#chatStatus. Clear localStorage ('nova-access-code','nova-demo-mode') then reload to get the login screen. A guided-tour panel overlays the right side of the dashboard after demo login. AI chat streams in ~4-6s. Backend was intentionally not retested (pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_novaro.py).
rca_of_the_issue: Both responsive defects trace to one edit accident in /app/server/public/index.html: the '@media (max-width: ...)' block that contained the mobile bottom tabbar and the single-column grid overrides lost its opening at-rule, leaving an unbalanced '}' and duplicated declarations. As a result mobile-only styles apply at all widths (bottom tabbar on desktop) while mobile grid overrides are gone (2-column grids overflow a 390px viewport, scrollWidth 537px).
